title: Meeting Scheduler
summary: Given two individuals' availability time slots and a meeting duration, find the earliest time slot that works for both and meets the duration.
statement: Given two individuals' availability time slots and a meeting duration, find the earliest time slot that works for both and meets the duration. If no such slot exists, return an empty array. Each time slot is defined as [start, end], indicating an inclusive range from start to end. Slots for each individual do not overlap.
constraints: Each person’s availability intervals are pairwise disjoint and have positive length.
Find the earliest overlap lasting at least duration.
Return its start and start plus duration, or an empty list.
reference_solution:
def earliest_meeting_slot(slots1,slots2,duration):
    slots1=sorted(slots1);slots2=sorted(slots2);i=j=0
    while i<len(slots1) and j<len(slots2):
        start=max(slots1[i][0],slots2[j][0]);end=min(slots1[i][1],slots2[j][1])
        if end-start>=duration:return [start,start+duration]
        if slots1[i][1]<slots2[j][1]:i+=1
        else:j+=1
    return []
